lines: Pitter-patter, drip, drop, drip,
Out the door goes little Pip,
Shiny boots of bright sky blue,
Ready, steady, hop on through!
Splash, splash, splish and splosh,
Puddle jumping, oh my gosh!
Count the puddles, one by one,
Rainy days are so much fun!
One big puddle by the tree,
Pip jumps in and shouts, whee!
Two small puddles by the gate,
Momo Turtle calls, wait, wait!
Splash, splash, splish and splosh,
Puddle jumping, oh my gosh!
Count the puddles, one by one,
Rainy days are so much fun!
Three round puddles in a row,
Jump with Pip, now here we go!
Hop and splash and laugh out loud,
Look, the sun peeks through the cloud!
Splash, splash, splish and splosh,
Puddle jumping, oh my gosh!
Count the puddles, one by one,
Rainy days are so much fun!
Rain says bye and sun says hi,
Rainbow colors fill the sky!

music.caption: cheerful children's nursery rhyme, bright friendly female vocal, ukulele, glockenspiel, hand claps, bouncy

voice.hook_text: Hello friends! It's raining! Let's count puddles with Pip!
voice.outro_text: Bye-bye, friends! Keep counting and see you next time!
